items.html: And behold, there are yet two more couplings in ZON of Atzilut. However, the first, which is more choice, is for the need of Yetzira, and the second coupling extends for the need of Assiya. Nevertheless, since the root of these two couplings is drawn from ZON, whose root was only the six extremities (VAK) alone, without Mochin — therefore, when it illuminates in Yetzira, in the secret of "six Sefirot nest in Yetzira," they illuminate in Yetzira only the six extremities alone, and there is no Partzuf in all of Yetzira more than VAK, without Mochin. Therefore there is no procreation for ZON of Yetzira, and all the more so in Assiya.
